Colors mark matching place pins strictly inside a mapped footprint, not the use of every room or floor. Stripes mean several categories; neutral means no confirmed match. Points outside or on an uncertain edge are left unassigned.

Sanzo Wada combination 320: Coral Red, Sulpher Yellow, Oil Green, Light Glaucous Blue. Credited digital conversions from Palette; textures and category symbols also distinguish the groups without hue. Footprints are the existing map geometry; no nearby building is guessed.
